system.description:
Every being leaves traces of its thoughts and emotions on the objects it handles and the places it lingers, especially amid powerful feeling. By touching an item and concentrating, you unlock a flood of images and sensations from its past. This power works only on objects or places — never on people, vampires, animals or other living creatures.

Touch the item and expend a Mental Trait for a turn of concentration. Each use lets you ask a Narrator one question, answered truthfully but as distorted images, flashes of passion and repeating sounds rather than plain facts: who last touched it, whether it figured in an emotionally stressful event (a murder, a romance, a rage), or what strong emotions drove a particular holder. Reading an object charged with especially powerful emotion — a murder weapon, a blanket clutched during childbirth — may overwhelm you with feelings not your own; at the Storyteller's discretion you suffer a derangement for the rest of the scene.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
